notes: v1.14.534 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 2a: CRASH-CART MODE DELETED. The owner killed this mode on 2026-07-02 and v1.14.248 removed both its doors (the OPS_TABS.crashcart key and the #ops-tab-strip pill), leaving the body in place for the sweep this campaign owns. That sweep is this ship: crashcart_toggle/exit/pickRack/render, the #crashcart-layer overlay div, and all ten .crashcart-* CSS rules are gone — 188 lines, 6,724 bytes. Re-verified against .533 before cutting: crashcart_toggle had ZERO callers (only its own definition and two comments), and no .crashcart-active rule survived anywhere, so the display:none layer could not have become visible even if something had called it. Dead in BOTH houses, so this is invisible under ?legacy=1 as well as under body.rd — there is no visible change to look for. No spec referenced crash-cart, so no test was rewritten. Three comment sites updated to record the removal; the .248 note that promised this sweep now reports it done.
